caption: Free covers the Scroll To Top button. Infinite Scroll, the feature in the app's name, sits only on the Unlimited plan at $4.99 a month.
Shopify's approval screen for Unlimited: $4.99 every 30 days after a 7-day trial ending 24 Nov, and a payment method is required. We approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
On the Free plan the Infinite Scroll embed shows Upgrade required, and every feature is off until you turn on the app embed in the theme. The store name is hidden.
The Scroll To Top settings on Free: about a dozen button styles, location, position and mobile behaviour. A yellow bar warns that nothing works until the app embed is on. The store name is hidden.
With the embed switched on in the theme editor, the round button shows bottom right on the homepage preview. We did not save the theme. The store name and a person in the stock photo are hidden.
